title: Bootstrap repository control plane
allowed: root control files; docs/**; .cursor/**; .github/**; scripts/**; reference/**
steps: Recover sources; inspect GitHub; commit authority/ownership/reference and workstream specs.
acceptance: Foundation check and reference hashes pass; commit/tree exists in canonical repo.
risk: Unsupported GitHub governance must remain explicitly pending.

title: Reconcile architecture and decision freeze
steps: Resolve current/transitional/target/superseded; record no P0 InventoryPort and central editor.
acceptance: Fresh agent answers owner/provider/migration questions from repo; no conflicting baseline.
risk: Do not relabel unknown runtime facts as approved.

title: Freeze domain and wire contracts
steps: Define money/IDs/customer/quote; separate payment/sale/print; generate TS and shared OpenAPI references.
acceptance: Schema references and examples pass; no client payment evidence accepted; all consumers use v1.
risk: Schema validation does not prove runtime or pricing correctness.

title: Audit live environment and isolate staging
steps: Development baseline SATISFIED via authenticated training evidence (ADR-011). Execute the operation-specific remaining-work checklist: outbound containment, data/write boundaries, synthetic fixtures, bridge service access and payment sandbox; retain production deltas for release.
acceptance: Track DEVELOPMENT BASELINE separately from WRITE-SAFETY/CUTOVER. Each relevant fact has observer/time/environment/evidence. No blanket local-development block; affected remote effects require containment proof. Issue #4 stays open for residuals.
risk: Known unsafe training side effects still block affected remote tests. Missing production access/fingerprints do not block local CORE-01 or BR-01.

title: Pin toolchain and create Next.js/CI scaffold
allowed: apps/pos-web/package.json; apps/pos-web/src/app/**; apps/pos-web/tsconfig.json; apps/pos-web/next.config.*; apps/pos-web/eslint.config.*; apps/pos-web/*test*; apps/pos-web/public/**; package.json; pnpm-lock.yaml; .github/workflows/**; docs/standards/TOOLCHAIN.md
steps: Verify supported versions/security; pin Node/pnpm/Next/TS; one app package, lockfile; wire lint/typecheck/test/build/e2e scripts; add real CI jobs.
acceptance: Clean install --frozen-lockfile; lint/typecheck/test/build pass; no nonexistent checks; blank app routes do not redesign UX.
risk: Only WS3 edits dependencies; do not rely on remembered TS versions.

title: Intake approved prototype and map scenarios
steps: Read immutable artifact; list component/token/view mapping; map every demo scenario to production test target.
acceptance: All reference screens and failure states mapped; no source bytes changed.
risk: Prototype fixture success is not runtime proof.

title: Convert tokens and responsive POS shell
steps: Implement tokens/navigation/layout; Login/Register gate components; provide route mounting instructions to WS3.
acceptance: Phone/tablet/desktop screenshots match reference; keyboard/focus/touch/reduced-motion checks pass.
risk: Do not edit app routes or add component library defaults without approval.

title: Build Sell cart barcode and customer workflow
steps: Wire catalog/variation/barcode views; preserve leading zeroes; persist cart revisions; customer switch/new-sale reset.
acceptance: Repeated scans increment; exact variation bypasses chooser; stale catalog/offline drafts work; no privileged imports.
risk: Source barcode mapping requires CP-04 before live use.

title: Integrate quote states and checkout eligibility
steps: Bind whole-cart quote; reject obsolete responses; explain disabled Pay; show accepted price/stock change review.
acceptance: Delayed quote cannot overwrite current revision; expired/offline quote blocks payment; customer change requotes.
risk: Mock quote states may start earlier; live checkout requires BR-05.

title: Integrate cash checkout and receipt UX
steps: Show prepare/resolve/cash/finalizing/complete separately; integrate print/reprint; preserve draft on failure.
acceptance: Double-click/timeout yields one order/tender; receipt only after consistent completion; failed print does not repeat sale.
risk: No browser cash/payment verification or fake receipt counters.

title: Implement payment returns and register states
steps: Add electronic pending/reconciling; historical returns/condition UI; blind shift close and variance states.
acceptance: Pending says do not charge again; damaged return not implicitly sellable; cashier cannot invent expected cash.
risk: Final policies/provider states are server-owned.

title: Finish Store Health and responsive PWA recovery UX
contracts: HealthPort, ReleasePolicy, local recovery view state
steps: Render health/attention/update-ready/passive-tab/offline/migration-blocked states; compare reference on real devices.
acceptance: Installed Android/iPhone or documented supported-device evidence; update deferred during payment; no loss of drafts/journal.
risk: If a device is not available, mark that release evidence missing.

title: Build bridge health and permission skeleton
steps: Create plugin bootstrap/build/check targets; capability guard; authenticated health and plugin detection.
acceptance: make check/test pass; unauthenticated/unauthorized calls rejected; health never claims parity from detection alone.
risk: Actual PHP/plugin versions required before compatibility declaration.

title: Implement isolated Woo runtime quote spike
steps: Create isolated whole-cart/customer context; snapshot quote; normalize response and restore globals in finally.
acceptance: Guest and retail parity; two concurrent customer contexts isolated; quote creates no order/stock side effects.
risk: Pricing hooks may require actual cart/session context; no guessed calculations.

title: Prove WoodMart tier pricing parity
steps: Capture below/at/above configured thresholds for simple/variation products; compare checkout line/tax/totals.
acceptance: Zero unexplained minor-unit differences, redacted golden corpus records plugin versions and timestamps.
risk: Do not hardcode threshold logic in bridge or UI.

title: Prove B2BKing commercial parity
steps: Test group/tier/customer-specific terms and relevant tax exemptions/min/max/multiples in actual runtime.
acceptance: All configured scenarios exact; unauthorized customer switch denied; no context leakage.
risk: Unconfigured cases documented as not applicable with evidence, never synthetic parity.

title: Resolve plugin overlap and pass pricing gate
steps: Exercise WoodMart+B2BKing together, variations and tax; identify controlling runtime behavior; retain golden fixtures.
acceptance: All required matrix rows pass or applicability approved; senior records pricing gate result.
risk: Any unexplained mismatch blocks dependent checkout.

title: Implement HPOS-safe idempotent prepare and resolve
steps: Use Woo CRUD; durable unique key/transaction claim; verify reserve/reduce; recovery mapping; cancellation guards.
acceptance: Same intent concurrent/retry creates one order; crash after order create recovers; last-unit race with online checkout cannot oversell; target HPOS mode passes.
risk: Order metadata lookup alone is not atomic deduplication or stock locking.

title: Implement verified commercial finalization and cancel
steps: Validate server evidence binding and exact order total; idempotent Woo completion; safe cancellation/expiry with no verified/pending money.
acceptance: Duplicate finalization reduces stock once; uncertain money blocks release; late success goes to attention.
risk: Do not let payment adapter call Woo or invent compensation.

title: Create POS operational schema and RLS
steps: One migration owner; schema for devices/registers/shifts/movements/workflow/outbox/projections; grants/RLS; unique constraints and append-only rules.
acceptance: Fresh local reset and supabase test db pass; anon/cross-tenant/wrong-location/forged actor denied; no duplicate commerce master.
risk: Service role bypass requires independent server authorization tests.

title: Implement staff auth abstraction and permission boundary
steps: Map Supabase Auth to server session; authorize staff/location/register; secure cookies/CSRF; timeout/revocation handling.
acceptance: Anonymous/expired/wrong role/wrong location requests denied; client capabilities never grant access; signout preserves journal safely.
risk: Buyer customer context must not become staff identity.

title: Wire BFF health and bridge connectivity
steps: Add normalized BFF routes and adapters; validate env; authenticated Supabase/bridge health; timeout/correlation handling.
acceptance: Browser→BFF→Supabase and bridge→Woo detection verified; no privileged secret in browser/network bundle.
risk: Detection is not pricing parity.

title: Implement catalog projection and durable local journal
steps: Sync versioned source projections/tombstones; barcode index; Dexie draft/journal append-before-send; retry/resolve; no prod PII fixtures.
acceptance: 5,000-item fixture benchmark; missing/duplicate barcode explicit; reconnect/update retains unacked intent; projection rebuild preserves drafts.
risk: Multi-stock and barcode source require live verification.

title: Build cash and FinalizeSale orchestration
steps: Open shift/cash ledger use cases; claim idempotency; cash proof; verify evidence; invoke commercial finalizer; outbox/receipt repair.
acceptance: Same cash command yields one net ledger effect; amount/currency/customer/scope mismatches rejected; Woo success/POS outage repairs without second sale.
risk: Bridge adapter mock may be used until BR-07; real slice waits on BR-07.

title: Integrate real cash sale and contract/E2E harness
steps: Add maintained schema validation/producer-consumer tests; run staff/register/scan/customer/quote/prepare/cash/receipt against isolated staging.
acceptance: One Woo order, one tender, one stock effect, one receipt and recorded POS workflow; exact CI/runtime evidence.
risk: Cannot call mock-only success a live integration pass.

title: Implement verified electronic payment and reconciliation
steps: Pin approved provider sandbox; prepare before initialize; validate signed webhook/server status, reference/amount/currency; dedupe events; late/unknown recovery.
acceptance: Duplicate/out-of-order callback no double charge; pending never reinitiates; browser success cannot finalize; late success handled explicitly.
risk: Account/live credentials/policy remain human-provided; no secrets in prompts.

title: Freeze refund wire refinement and implement safe returns
allowed: docs/contracts/**; docs/decisions/**; apps/pos-web/src/core/**; apps/pos-web/src/server/**; supabase/**; tests/integration/returns/**
steps: First freeze missing bridge commercial-refund/restock commands with WS2 review; then historic economics/approval/refund workflow; request separate WS2 subtask in owned paths.
acceptance: Partial/repeated return quantity capped; one refund and independent one stock effect; damaged/quarantine does not restock; unknown refund resolves.
risk: WS3 does not silently edit plugin; dependent WS2 task recorded before bridge implementation.

title: Implement safe PWA lifecycle and operational close
allowed: apps/pos-web/src/local/**; apps/pos-web/src/core/**; apps/pos-web/src/server/**; apps/pos-web/public/**; supabase/**; tests/integration/recovery/**
steps: Controlled service worker update, retention, schema migration/multi-tab leader; non-destructive repair; atomic blind close and immutable Z.
acceptance: Installed old version + unacked operation survives update/reconnect; no activation mid-tender; close retry yields one Z; cash variance retained.
risk: Never clear critical stores or call a UI demo toggle lifecycle proof.

title: Run failure security and invariant qualification
steps: Inject outages after each external effect; reconcile; test auth/RLS negative paths, concurrent operations and updated installed PWA.
acceptance: No duplicate order/tender/refund/restock; no lost journal; consistent shift/receipt; all release blockers resolved or affected capability explicitly excluded.
risk: Deadline never waives financial or data safety gates.

title: Rehearse cutover and execute approved pilot
steps: Verify backups/restore, live statutory process, devices, VitePOS queue and inventory; rehearse rollback; obtain human signoff; controlled one-register pilot.
acceptance: Recorded signoff; no two active POS writers for pilot register; proven rollback preserving new sales; healthy shifts before permanent VitePOS removal.
risk: No production writes/deactivation authorized by task completion alone; human promotion required.
